title: Adding a new IAM API requires updating features.go and register.go together
answers: I added a new IAM API constant, what else needs to change?
Where do I register a new supported IAM API name for startup config?
Why isn't my new API showing up in EnabledAPIs()?
body: A new gate-able IAM API needs: a new `API` constant and entry in `supportedAPIs` plus a bool field on `Features`, a case in `featureForAPI`, and a line in `Features.SetAPIs` — all in pkg/registry/apis/iam/features.go. It also needs a corresponding `featureEnabled(ctx, flagKey, ...)` call wired into whichever of InstallSchema / UpdateAPIGroupInfo / GetAPIRoutes in pkg/registry/apis/iam/register.go actually uses that gate. Missing either side means the API can be enabled via startup config but never actually installed, or vice versa.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/iam/features.go and pkg/registry/apis/iam/register.go when adding/removing a gated IAM API surface
